_comment: Best-effort per-1M-token USD price estimates for cost tracking ONLY. NOT authoritative billing. Models absent here (image/audio/realtime/tts/video/rerank/transcription) record cost as unknown rather than zero. inputPer1M/outputPer1M are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
_source: Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices), serviceName eq 'Foundry Models', for Azure retail meters. MAI-Thinking-1 comes from the official Azure MAI registry asset (`azureml://registries/azure-mai/models/MAI-Thinking-1/versions/2026-06-01`), which publishes $2/$8 per 1M input/output tokens. Claude in Microsoft Foundry is billed through Azure Marketplace Claude Consumption Units and has no matching Retail Prices row; its rate comes from Anthropic's official Microsoft Foundry pricing documentation (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing). Rates are undiscounted GlobalStandard/PAYG list prices, excluding Batch, Priority/Fast, cached-input, and Provisioned meters.
_caveats: Flat per-model rates cannot express every Azure meter dimension. (1) Long-context: gpt-5.4/5.4-pro bill a higher tier above 272k tokens and the gpt-5.6 family above its short-context tier - roughly 2x these rates. (2) Cached input bills ~10% of input and is not modeled, so estimates are conservative (over-report) on cache-heavy traffic. (3) Priority Processing bills ~2x standard; the app's own P0/P1 fairness queue is a proxy-side concept and does NOT put traffic on those meters. (4) model-router has no meter of its own - it bills as whichever model it routes to, so its entry is a mid-range stand-in. (5) DeepSeek-V3.2 publishes only DataZone meters. (6) Claude US Data Zone applies a 1.1x multiplier; this flat entry records the GlobalStandard base rate, so Data Zone calls are underestimated by 10%. (7) MAI-Thinking-1 is Preview; pricing and limits can change before GA.
